title: Shaming for Tax Enforcement
eligible_reason: Single policy date: the naming-and-shaming threat was announced for all Slovenian taxpayers at once in 2012. Identification is a regression discontinuity at the shaming debt threshold (Figures 3-7, 10, OA1) and a DiD of tax-debt changes on the continuous ex-ante shaming probability x Dthreat (Table 2, Figures 8-9, A7-A8), i.e. a continuous-intensity interaction around one date. Actual shaming (three lists, April-June 2013) is analysed with cross-sectional regressions of outcome changes on sl_share for first-list debtors (Figure 11), not a staggered TWFE.
